prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a rear-end collision. The patient had 12 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1413; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with cervical strain. Over the course of twelve visits, care included physical examination, range-of-motion assessment, a structured therapy program, and home exercise instruction. The reported injury is plausible given the mechanism of the collision. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm soft tissue injury to the cervical spine, with objective limitation in motion and palpable muscle tightness. No prior injury to the neck or upper back is known from the patient's history. The course of treatment followed a typical pattern, with visit frequency decreasing as symptoms improved and range of motion returned toward baseline. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service rendered, with no repeated or duplicate entries. At the time of the final visit, the patient was discharged to self-directed home exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
